As a Production Worker, you will help prepare and print company logos on T-shirts and workwear. You work in a small, friendly team of about 15 people, in a clean production hall with a normal temperature - no cold! The workday is 7.5 hours with regular breaks, and you'll always have support from colleagues. This is a great job if you like working with your hands, want a stable schedule, and appreciate a tidy workplace. Basic English language skills (A2) are enough, so you can easily understand instructions and communicate at work. If you value precision and want a steady job with nice people, this is for you!

Would you like to work in a greenhouse? 
We are looking for all-round greenhouse workers for various modern horticultural companies. Whether you prefer working with vegetables, flowers, plants, or if you want to clean and install greenhouses, there is always a role that suits you! Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that the products are grown with care and prepared for shipment. 
From tomatoes to flowers like roses and chrysanthemums - you can contribute to this colorful and growing world. Do you prefer to work independently or in a team? No problem, there is a suitable role for everyone! 
Take the step today towards a varied and exciting job.
